description: Land Title Settlement Department - Paluwewa, Higurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120017
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels. It involves the declaration of title ownership for numerous plots of land, including details of owners, extent of land, nature of title, and any encumbrances. The content falls under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements under the Registration of Title Act.
